G3_FORMAL_LOCK.requires: complete confirmatory identities, runtime bindings, price snapshot, immutable overlay hashes, independent ACCEPT, and explicit owner approval

PILOT.requires: G3 formal lock and explicit Pilot authorization

PILOT_TO_CONFIRMATORY.requires: all Pilot transition criteria and a separate owner comment binding the exact confirmatory manifest

SCORING.requires: complete authorized evidence and scoring authorization

FINAL_ACCEPTANCE.requires: independent review and explicit owner acceptance

failClosedOn: provider or workflow activity without authorization
claimBoundary: Contract implementation and review only. No execution, scoring, effectiveness, readiness, merge, or acceptance claim.
